comment: How the component catalogue shows a model: <model-viewer> attributes shared by the 3D viewers on the family pages (scripts/components.mjs) and the thumbnails rendered by docs/screens/components.py, so a thumbnail is the viewer's first frame. The lighting (environment map, exposure, tone mapping) and each part's camera angle come from the export, docs/components/data/components.json, which builds them from the editor's viewport look.
